weaknesses.title: LOOKUPFILE/KVFILESET sep must be string literal — bare str var fails
weaknesses.detail: LET s=":"; LOOKUPFILE p key s → miss; same for KVFILESET third arg bare SEP. Agents cannot pass env sep without EQS branch to literals. Same class as HEADFILE bare n.
weaknesses.repro: SYS LOOKUPFILE p "warn" s with s=":" → N=0

weaknesses.title: LOOKUP/KVSET are bag; LOOKUPFILE/KVFILESET are disk plates
weaknesses.detail: LOOKUP on multi-line string may not peel file path. Classic dual-family trap.

weaknesses.title: First key= only — duplicate keys leave orphans
weaknesses.detail: get returns first port=; set rewrites first only, second port=2 remains. No unique-key enforce or multi-get.

weaknesses.title: Empty key KVFILESET appends "=value" line
weaknesses.detail: LOOKUP empty misses; SET empty creates garbage plate row. Asymmetric empty-key policy.

weaknesses.title: KVFILESET creates missing files with no confirm/mode flag
weaknesses.detail: Typo path silently creates new plate. Useful but easy to scatter plates.

weaknesses.title: WRITE trailing NL omit on VAL and last plate line
weaknesses.detail: cat -A VAL often no final $; mode=soft glued to meta after write.

weaknesses.title: No KVFILEDEL / multi-sep freeform beyond literal branches
weaknesses.detail: Delete key requires DROPALLMATCHFILE key= glue. Arbitrary seps need language literal support.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE env silently softens get miss

workarounds: Branch EQS SEP ":" to literal ":" for LOOKUPFILE/KVFILESET
Use LOOKUPFILE not LOOKUP for disk plates
Uniq keys before set; purge duplicates with DROPALLMATCHFILE
Reject empty key at agent layer
Pick canonical plate path carefully — set creates missing
language_gaps: Bare string var as LOOKUPFILE/KVFILESET sep
WRITE trailing NL; help dual LOOKUP vs LOOKUPFILE
Arbitrary sep without literal branch explosion
issues_faced: Bare SEP var parse fail blocked custom set — fixed with : literal branch
Bare A2 sep on get also failed — same fix
Empty key SET append =x is live footgun
